description: Fix a flaky test in /home/ga/workspace/payment_service/tests/test_payment.py that passes locally but fails in CI. The test currently uses 'time.sleep(2)' to wait for async payment processing, causing race conditions. Replace the fixed sleep with a polling loop that checks 'payment.status' until it becomes 'completed', with a timeout of 5-10 seconds. Add a comment explaining the fix (mention race condition or async processing). The payment processor runs in a background thread, so the test must wait for the actual condition rather than assuming a fixed duration.
